heading: Servicing records
lead: The Archivist shall provide and maintain facilities he considers necessary or desirable for servicing records in his custody that are not exempt from examination by statutory or other restrictions.

notes.heading: Historical and Revision Notes
notes.text: Based on 44 U.S. Code, 1964 ed., § 397(d) (June 30, 1949, ch. 288, title V, § 507, as added Sept. 5, 1950, ch. 849, § 6(d), 64 Stat. 583).

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 2110 was renumbered section 2114 of this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1984—Pub. L. 98–497, § 107(a)(4), substituted “Archivist” for “Administrator of General Services”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 1984 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 98–497 effective Apr. 1, 1985, see section 301 of Pub. L. 98–497, set out as a note under section 2102 of this title.
